name: MedQA: Medical Licensing Examination Question Answering Benchmark
description: MedQA is a large-scale, multilingual question answering benchmark curated from official medical board examinations across three countries and languages: the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) in English, the Mainland China National Medical Licensing Examination (MCMQE) in Simplified Chinese, and the Taiwan Medical Licensing Examination (TWMLE) in Traditional Chinese. Developed by researchers at MIT CSAIL and published in JMIR Medical Informatics and Findings of EMNLP, the dataset contains 61,097 multiple-choice clinical questions covering basic sciences, internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, and clinical ethics. MedQA provides the benchmark for clinical reasoning in large language models and biomedical AI systems.

license.name: MIT License (Code) / Third-Party Copyrighted Medical Examinations (Data)
license.notes: The repository source code is released under the MIT License. However, the benchmark question bank comprises medical licensing examination questions (USMLE, MCMLE, TMLMLE) and medical textbook excerpts owned by third-party medical examination boards and academic publishers. Commercial permissions for the underlying questions are unknown and not granted by the code license.
